JUDGMENT:
                         O R D E R
     Leave granted.
     The only  controversy is  as regards the entitlement of
the respondents to the additional amount under Section 23(1-
A) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894. Since the award of the
Collector is of June 4, 1979, the claimants are not entitled
to the  additional amount  under Section 23(1-A) of the said
Act.
     The appeal  is accordingly allowed to the above extent.
The Order of the High Court is set aside. No costs.
